page.layout: One column of dictionary entries in Hebrew and Latin, with a rule and a section letter ט in the middle; the Hebrew running head at the top centre and the page number at the top right; a catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: reddam, Jesa.49.37. ubi Scheva sub Cheth est loco Cateph-pathach. Fut. יחיתן Terrefaciet eas, Hab.2.17. cum vocali longâ loco Dagesch, pro יחתן.
חת m. Terror: לבלי־חת Absq terrore, Job.41.24. id est, intrepidè: Aff. וחתכם Et terror vester, Gen.9.2.
חתָּה f. Idem: Construct. חתת אלהים Terror Dei, Genes.35.5.
חתית m. Idem, Ezech.32.27. Aff. חתיתו Terrorem meum, v.32. scribitur cum ו sed legitur per י.
מחתֶּרת f. Terror, Consternatio, Contritio: Constr. מחתת דלים Terror tenuium, Prov.10.15.
טאם Unde geminatâ mediâ radicali in Pih. טאטא Everrit: Præter. וטאטאתיה Et everram eam, Jesa.14.23.

מטאטא m. Everriculum, Scopæ, ibid. Apud Rabbinos טיאוט Everritio, Expurgatio, quod legitur apud R. Salomonem, Jesa.28. verf.17. Apud Talmudicos: Nesciebant quid esset וטאטאתיי donec audirent famulam quandam Arabicam dicentem sociæ suæ, שקלי טאטיתא וטאטי ביתא Accipe scopas, & scopato domum, Megilla fol.11.

טבח Mactavit: Præt. אשר טבחתי Quam mactavi, 1.Sam.25.11. Part. שורך טבוח Ubi bos tuus mactatus fuerit, Deuter.28.31. Ab. Esra Prov.9.2. scribit, טבח pro diversa punctatione, in lingua Arabica esse Mactare vel Coquere. Hinc, quæ sequitur, Nominis significatio.

page.notes: Several Hebrew words are printed in small or worn type and are copied as far as legible; the vowel points in the entries are hard to see at this scan resolution, so the pointing is only approximate. The Hebrew heads of the entries (טאב, החתָּרת, מחתֶּרת, התחתים) and the Hebrew in the Apud Talmudicos line are the least certain. The word "Job" and "Jesa" are copied as printed. The running head is taken from the Hebrew letters at the top centre. The section letter ט, the rule and the catchword are as printed.
